title: Banja Luka gathering against Republika Srpska COVID restrictions
location: Banja Luka city center, in front of the City Administration building
organizer: A group of dissatisfied citizens; exact organizer unknown. Interviewee Željko Tatić stated his hospitality association did not organize the event.
participants_original: Several dozen citizens, as reported by Anadolu Agency and the Buka-credited 6yka page; no exact bounds stated. BN provides no city-specific attendance estimate.
threshold_50_evidence: Threshold unresolved. Contemporary accounts say ‘several dozen’, which does not supply a clearly supported count of at least 50; no numeric bounds have been published in the opened accounts.

start_date.summary: Each opened report dates the gathering to 28 October 2020.

location.summary: AA identifies the City Administration frontage; BN also identifies the protest as outside Banja Luka City Administration.

participants.summary: Both say several dozen but publish no numeric bounds; BN gives no Banja Luka count. The 50-person threshold remains unresolved.

demands.summary: Participants opposed Republika Srpska Crisis Staff measures: hospitality hours/live-music restrictions and school closures. This targets RS policy within Bosnia and Herzegovina.

organizer.summary: Informal group of dissatisfied citizens; exact organizer not named. The hospitality association is expressly said not to have organized it.

state_response.summary: Unknown; opened reports do not give detailed government/police response.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; not described in opened reports.

notes: One local gathering with hospitality workers, musicians and parents; do not combine it with separate events in Bijeljina or Brčko or pool multiple city counts. 6yka credits Buka and may be a republication; it is not counted as independent corroboration. No end date inferred from publication silence.
open_questions: Can another contemporary source establish a simultaneous attendance of at least 50 at this Banja Luka gathering?
Exact organizer and detailed state response/violence remain unknown.
Check neighboring month sources for event/episode continuity without merging by shared COVID-measures theme.
Official ccode remains null pending verified baseline mapping.

organizer: A group of parents; exact organizer unknown.
participants_original: BN reports a group of parents began signing a petition; no participant count stated.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown. The report does not give the group size or establish a 50-person public gathering.

start_date.summary: BN describes this action as occurring on 28 October.

location.summary: BN says parents began petitioning in the Bijeljina city center.

demands.summary: Parents sought return to in-person school after the RS Crisis Staff suspended classes.

organizer.summary: A group of parents; no formal organizer identified.

notes: Preserved as a separate action from the Banja Luka gathering and Bijeljina hospitality protest. The article describes petition signing by parents, not a quantified demonstration; exact public-gathering form and threshold remain unclear.
open_questions: Was this petition activity an organized public gathering, and were at least 50 simultaneous participants present?

title: GRAS workers protest at company premises over unpaid wages and service problems
organizer: GRAS workers; union president announced the start time
participants_original: No attendance estimate in the opened Klix or RFE account.
threshold_50_evidence: Unresolved; the two opened contemporary reports provide no headcount.
inclusion_ambiguity: Company-premises protest; public access and a demand directed to a state actor are not clear from the available report. The action is not upgraded to qualifying event without evidence on count and target.

event_date.summary: Klix body dates the protest inside GRAS premises to 16 October 2020.

location.summary: Klix identifies company premises; RFE separately refers to a 16 October protest in the GRAS yard.

demand.summary: Klix reports unpaid salaries and company operating problems; state-level policy target remains unclear.

threshold_50.summary: Neither source reports the number of participants.
